tiktok.caption:
Texting my ADHD brain on a work day 🧠

Me: today we're sending the proposal. Brain: love that for us. Me: opening the doc. Brain: wait, what if we check email first? By 11 we'd checked it twice. By 2 I knew exactly what to write and my brain said "but what if we didn't".

So I told FOCO. Step 1 was 3 minutes: open last proposal as a template. Even my brain could do that. Sent at 4:10.

What does your brain text you at 9am? 👇
Save this for your next proposal day 📌

You don't need another to-do list. You need help starting. The app on the slides is FOCO, link in bio 💜
